Your responsibilities

Duties include academic services in the project named above. Research associates may also pursue further academic qualifications outside of their work responsibilities. They may also pursue doctoral studies outside of working duties.

The Research Associate will work on the project “Tunable Hydraulic and Capillarity-Driven Water Flow in Nanoporous Materials” which is part of the Research Area “Fluid Transport Materials” within the Cluster of Excellence – BlueMat: Water-Driven Materials”. In conventional porous media, hydraulic permeability and capillary pressure during imbibition are determined by static geometry, water-solid interaction, and fluid viscosity. This project aims to integrate mechanisms for stimulus-dependent changes in the pore size and solid-liquid interaction, resulting in tunable permeability and polarity-induced changes of local capillary forces. Combining this strategy with multiscale 3D structuring and local interface modification will enable materials that can locally and reversibly switch imbibition ability and kinetics. This project focuses on understanding dynamic fluid-solid interactions upon reversible tuning by external stimuli in 3D multiscale porous structures. The project addresses the following research questions: How can we explore the water-solid interfacial structure and measure the impact of tunable pore size und surface polarity on fluid transport? How can we tailor the flow and permeability rates by adjusting multiscale porosity and response to stimuli? How can we fabricate structured 3D (nano)porous materials with locally and reversibly tunable permeability and surface polarity?

The Research Associate specific responsibilities include:

synthesis of multiscale porous materials with stimuli-induced tunable porosity and surface polarity as powders and 3D monoliths
characterization of the materials with respect to their structure, porosity and thermal stability
investigation of the structural and dynamic behavior of water or aqueous solutions in nanoconfinement
developing and co-authoring articles for publication in scientific journals
collaborating with other research groups in the cluster and outside
participating in experiments at large scale synchrotron and neutron facilities
supervising BSc and MSc students
contributing to project administration and reporting
Your profile

A university degree in a relevant field.

a master’s degree in chemistry or materials science
we seek an outstanding scientist with substantive expertise in the area of synthetic chemistry of nanoporous materials and their characterization combined with a basic physical understanding of phase transformations and fluidics
experience
in the synthesis of inorganic or hybrid materials with single or hierarchical pore structures by means of soft- and/or hard-templating routes or other techniques
characterization of these materials using XRD, TG/DTA/MS, gas physisorption, SEM, TEM
characterization of nanoconfined water by NMR, IR/Raman, DSC

The Content Personalization & Governance team at Zalando provides personalized content selection and ranking for Zalando’s discovery surfaces. As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will play a central role in building and scaling the next generation of these discovery systems across the platform. Act as a mentor and technical sparring partner to scientists across the team, advocating for rigorous experimental methodologies and actively contributing to Zalando’s broader science community.

WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF YOU HAVE…

An advanced degree (M.Sc., Ph.D.) or equivalent industry experience in Machine Learning, Applied Economics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

6+ years of applied science experience leading end-to-end AI/ML solutions from ideation and research to large-scale production, ideally combined with a strong publication record of advancing state-of-the-art methods for real-world applications.

Deep hands-on expertise in Deep Learning, Recommender Systems, Reinforcement Learning/Bandits, Multi-Objective Optimization, and Causal ML coupled with extensive experience designing and evaluating complex A/B experiments.

Proven leadership in shaping scientific roadmaps and collaborating across Product, Science, Engineering, and senior leadership to discover business opportunities and solve complex problems with scientific solutions.

Strong technical proficiency in Python and Deep Learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) for RL, and modern AI coding assistants and agents, along with hands-on experience building and scaling production recommender and ranking engines on cloud platforms (AWS).

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/einen ML Data Scientist (w/m/d) in Duisburg

Kein Einsatz ohne uns“ – Beim Landesamt für Zentrale Polizeiliche Dienste können Sie – auch ohne Uniform – punkten und mit Ihren Ideen und Ihrem Engagement die öffentliche Sicherheit gestalten.

Als Teil unseres engagierten Teams arbeiten Sie in spannenden KI-Projekten und trägst aktiv dazu bei, die Herausforderungen der modernen Polizeiarbeit zu meistern. Wenn Sie motiviert sind, frische Ideen einzubringen und in einem kreativen und wertschätzenden Umfeld zu agieren, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!


Wir sorgen für:
Einen sicheren und sinnstiftenden Arbeitsplatz – auch in Krisenzeiten
Mobiles Arbeiten und eine optimale Work-Life-Balance in Voll- und Teilzeit
Kooperationen mit Familienserviceeinrichtungen
Zahlreiche Fortbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Betriebsrente, Jahressonderzahlungen und vermögenswirksame Leistungen


Wir wollen, dass Sie einen guten Job machen. Dafür müssen die Rahmenbedingungen stimmen. Denn es geht um viel: Sie arbeiten in sensiblen Sicherheitsbereichen am Herzen der nordrhein-westfälischen Polizei.


Ihre neuen Aufgaben:

Wir sind ein Dezernat, das sich auf die Entwicklung intelligenter Systeme und datengetriebener Softwarelösungen spezialisiert hat. Unser Ziel ist es, durch den Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) und Machine Learning innovative Produkte und Services zu schaffen, die reale Probleme effizient lösen.

Als ML Data Scientist (Maschinelles Lernen Data Scientist) übernehmen Sie bei uns eine Schlüsselrolle im Bereich von Machine Learning. Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist es, aus komplexen, strukturierten und unstrukturierten Datensätzen verwertbare Erkenntnisse zu generieren und datengetriebene Modelle zu extrahieren, die Problemstellungen lösen.

Dabei übernehmen Sie die Datenanalyse und explorative Datenanalyse (EDA) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Data Engineers sowie die Durchführung von explorativer Datenanalysen zur Qualitätsbewertung, Musterentdeckung und Hypothesenbildung
Sie sind verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und das Training von Modellen und die Optimierungen/Feinabstimmung (Fine-Tuning) großer vortrainierter Sprachmodelle (LLMs) für spezifische Anwendungsfälle
Sie übernehmen das Feature Engineering und die Datenaufbereitung sowie die Entwicklung hochwertiger Feature-Pipelines (u.a. Zeitreihen-Feature, Bild-Feature) und entwickeln die notwendige RAG-Architektur für wissensbasierte Anwendungen
Außerdem ist Ihre Aufgabe die Modellbewertung, Erklärbarkeit durch Einsatz von Erklärbarkeits-Methoden, Standardisierung der Auswertungen (Analysen) und Dokumentationen (Modellkarten, etc.) sowie die Durchführung von Robustheitstests.
Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie die Übergabe von trainierten Modellen in produktionsreifer Form und Mitgestaltung der CI/CD-Pipelines unter Berücksichtigung des notwendigen Modell-Monitorings, automatisierten Retrainings sowie die Dokumenationen aller Deployments.

Was Sie mitbringen müssen:
Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium mit Diplom oder Master in den Bereichen Informatik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Mathematik, Physik oder in einem vergleichbaren Bereich
Zudem müssen Sie die Bereitschaft zur Durchführung einer erweiterten Sicherheitsüberprüfung mitbringen. Dies setzt voraus, dass sich Ihr Wohnsitz seit mindestens fünf Jahren in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland oder einem Mitgliedsstaat der EU befindet.

Wünschenswert wäre:
Sie bringen bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Data Engineering oder Data Science mit und haben Kenntnisse im Aufbau und in der Nutzung von Data Lakes und Data Warehouses
Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung in der explorativen Datenanalyse (EDA) und Visualisierung und verfügen über detailliertes Wissen über die aktuell verfügbaren Modelle und deren Eignung für die spez. Einsatzzwecke
Sie bringen methodische Kenntnisse über Statistik, Modellvalidierung, Hyperparameter-Optimierung, spezifisch auch Feature-Engineering mit
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind für Sie selbstverständlich
Sie sind vertraut mit Containerisierung und Orchestrierung (Kubernetes) und bringen Kenntnisse in CI/CD-Prozessen für Machine-Learning-Modelle mit.
Sie besitzen ein gutes Verständnis für Feature Engineering. Modelltraining und Modellbewertung
Analytisches Denken, Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, Teamfähigkeit und eine gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit runden Ihr Profil ab

At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.




Bench Scientist Biotechnology (all genders), Frankfurt a.M.




As a Bench Scientist Biotechnology, you lead scientific work on strain development and optimization, directly supporting bioprocess R&D projects. You design and execute experiments, analyze biological data, and communicate findings clearly across multidisciplinary teams while ensuring high scientific rigor and compliance. If you enjoy hands-on biotechnology and want to drive innovative solutions with internal and external partners, we look forward to your application.




YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES




Lead scientific projects focused on strain optimization to support bioprocess R&D projects
Design and execute molecular biology, metabolic engineering, and strain engineering experiments to develop and optimize microbial production hosts
Generate genetically engineered strains using cloning, genome editing, and pathway engineering techniques
Characterize engineered strains through molecular, analytical, and fermentation-based assessments
Analyze and interpret biological data and communicate scientific findings to multidisciplinary project teams
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and communities (including biocatalysis, analytical sciences, biotechnology, and chemistry)
Independently plan, coordinate, execute, analyze, document, and present project progress to ensure clear communication of results and insights
Drive new concepts and innovative solutions together with internal and external partners



WHO YOU ARE




Completed university degree with several years of relevant experience, or a completed Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or a related discipline
Strong scientific track record and excellent problem-solving skills
Strong scientific and hands-on experimental expertise in molecular biology techniques, biochemistry and/or biotechnology
Hands-on experience with methods such as PCR/qPCR, cloning, CRISPR or genetic engineering approaches, transformation/transfection, protein expression and purification, protein characterization, and strain engineering
Experience with different expression hosts, with an emphasis on yeast
Experience with microbial cultivation or fermentation is beneficial, especially in applied research settings
Digital mindset, effective and adaptable communication skills, and a strong commitment to cross-functional collaboration
Excellent English language skills required; German is a plus



Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!




We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 77.300€ and 93.800€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
Whether it’s hybrid work models or part-time arrangements: Whenever it is possible, you will have the flexibility to work how, when and where it is best for you.
Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much moreWe support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
We embrace diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.



The position will be based in Frankfurt a.M. until the end of 2027. As of January 1, 2028, the position is planned to relocate to Monheim.




Be You. Be Bayer.




YOUR APPLICATION

This is your opportunity to tackle the world’s biggest challenges with us: Maintaining our health, feeding growing populations and slowing the rate of climate change. You have a voice, ideas and perspectives and we want to hear them. Because our success begins with you. Be part of something big. Be Bayer.
